flows.representativeInput: Gone-symbol fixture: feature branch removes getWidget; docs/context/guide.md line 5 names `getWidget()`; that line is edited to name `keep`.
flows.expected: --verify reports 0 remaining for that finding and exits 0.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-4-1] passed: exit 0, status pass, no remaining getWidget finding, cleared 1. 9/9 tests in the file pass.
P1 valid fix -> exit 0 pass cleared 1. X3 pure deletion of the named line -> pass. N1 no edits -> clean, message null.

flows.representativeInput: Same fixture with edits outside the named line: AGENTS.md, unlisted docs/context/other.md, nested entry files, renames, untracked files, mode changes, symlinks, binary and no-hunk diffs.
flows.expected: Exit non-zero naming each offending path, message null; per brief end-edits, also refuse any line outside the listed findings.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-4-2] tests passed: AGENTS.md edit refused naming AGENTS.md; docs/context/other.md edit refused naming it; unnamed line 3 refused; review-a-3 tests (extra lines, untracked, staged-hidden, non-clearing edit) refused.

Refused as expected: M3 chmod unnamed file; S1 symlink replacing named file; R1/R2 git mv (both paths named); D1 git rm named file; E1 docs/context/sub/CLAUDE.md; E2 docs/context/AGENTS.md; E4 docs/sub/agents.md; X1 extra line in hunk; X2 named+blank deleted; X4 appended line; I2 staged extra line.

B1 named file rewritten with a NUL byte plus arbitrary text -> exit 0 status pass, message 'docs: tidy 0 doc lines ...'. B2 .git/info/attributes '*.md binary' then the named file fully rewritten as plain text -> pass. B3 .git/info/attributes diff=x + git config diff.x.textconv=true, file rewritten -> pass. B4 committed .gitattributes '*.md -diff', file rewritten -> pass. In each, lines 1-4 (no finding names them) are replaced and verify passes.

limits: E3: docs/context/AGENTS.override.md is not treated as an entry file (passes); the spec names only AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, see follow-up.
A1/A2 (assume-unchanged/skip-worktree AGENTS.md) and U1 (.git/info/exclude new file) pass, but git commit -a / add -A would not include those edits; recorded as limits.

flows.representativeInput: Passing fixture after the valid fix; fixture with no edits; fixture with a mode-only change.
flows.expected: Subject 'docs: tidy N doc lines after <short head>' plus trailer 'Joycraft-Tidy: <base>..<head>'; nothing to commit with no edits.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-4-3] passed: subject 'docs: tidy 1 doc line after <head7>', trailer 'Joycraft-Tidy: <merge-base>..<head>'; no edits -> status clean, message null.
M1 chmod +x on the named file with no line edit -> exit 0 status pass with message 'docs: tidy 0 doc lines after ...' (a commit message for a change that edits no line). Same no-hunk path as B1-B4.

unresolved: f1-no-hunk-bypass: tidy --verify passes a full rewrite of a named page when Git prints no hunk for it.

findings.summary: tidyVerify reads only @@ hunk headers from 'git diff HEAD -U0 --no-ext-diff -- <file>'. When Git prints no hunks for a named file (binary content, a 'binary'/-diff attribute in .gitattributes or untracked .git/info/attributes, a textconv driver, or a mode-only change) nothing is refused and verify passes with 'tidy 0 doc lines'. Any named context page can be rewritten in full (probes B1-B4, M1, M2). Fix direction: pass --text (-a) and --no-textconv to the hunk diff, and refuse a changed file whose diff yields no hunk or shows a mode/type change.

cleanup.mjs entryFiles is ['AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md'], but entry-check.mjs:14 and mapReached in this file also count AGENTS.override.md. A docs/context/AGENTS.override.md naming a gone symbol is fixable and its edit passes verify (probe E3).
findings.assumption: The spec names only AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; adding AGENTS.override.md matches the brief's 'never an entry file'.

findings.summary: The staged view is checked for line scope but not for clearing: an index edit that still names getWidget passes when the working tree holds a valid fix (probe I1). A 'git commit' without -a would commit the unverified index.
findings.assumption: The spec says verify measures the working tree; the scope check still bounds the index.

findings.summary: A named line clears its finding by adding a space inside the backticks or dropping them, while it still names the gone symbol (probes C1, C2). The named line may also become arbitrary text (X5); that is the script-named design.
The queue declares no check input, so startup trace showed spec-4-1..3 untraced. tests/runtime-cleanup-tidy-verify.test.ts tags all three; add it as a check input.
The installed .joycraft/runtime/cleanup.mjs predates this feature and differs from payload/. Sync before release if AGENTS.md requires it.
